dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that preference for routine correspondence. Required documents will still be provided, but your preference for a direct covering message can be recorded.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would be helpful. I keep business administration separate from my personal paperwork, but both tend to arrive while I'm occupied. A clear subject line helps me find the message again without searching through the whole inbox.
